title: I turned my 20-minute lock-on action RPG's single valley into a small world
author: offroadspike
selftext:
Trollgate is a short action RPG built to answer one question: does a lock-on spellblade feel good in small, deliberate fights? You hold the left trigger to lock on, fight with a sword and five spells chosen as you level, and finish against a troll with an enrage timer.

1.0's players found it fun, so 1.1 kept the fight and rebuilt the place around it: a town, a forest road to a second quest hub, ten zones that each look like nowhere else on the map, ground with height, a river and a lake, light that changes at the graveyard and the troll's arena, and a cave with a mini-boss. It also got smaller to download (82 MB to about 65) by shipping each asset pack's texture atlas once and having every prop share it.

Made by one person in Godot 4.7, with an AI coding assistant; Synty's 3D packs for the world, a hero model generated with Meshy and an AI-painted UI. Free in the browser, on Windows and on Mac. Happy to answer questions about how it was made.

[https://sarynth.itch.io/trollgate](https://sarynth.itch.io/trollgate)
